essence: The meditator should envision the deity seated in that locus, adorned with white ornaments.
The practitioner should recollect the figure being sprinkled by all with milky water.
Through this visualization one experiences diverse enjoyments and attains a form according to will.
One should meditate on the figure seated on a moon-seat and touched by the moon above.
The meditation yields a state free from old age, death, and all diseases.
